records.statement: Itraconazole inhibited Hedgehog activity in cells and mouse tumors. Human pathway findings are mixed: a prostate study measured skin GLI1 changes, a lung study found no significant GLI1 or PTCH1 change in paired skin samples and no significant decrease in its tumor comparison against unrelated sample sets, and a five-person basal-cell-carcinoma study used sequential arsenic trioxide and itraconazole. Low clinical inference. A cell signal and an indirect or combination biomarker change do not establish cancer benefit or consistent inhibition in treated human tumors.
